title: Wow (Owen Wilson)
blurb: Owen Wilson has been saying this exact word, in this exact tone, across roughly three decades of films, and at some point the internet noticed and started collecting. Supercuts run to hundreds of instances. What makes it the most useful astonishment sound available is how relaxed it is — no shock, no volume, just a mild and entirely sincere acknowledgement that something has happened. It fits a catastrophic fail, a genuine achievement or a mildly surprising sandwich equally well, and scales to anything in between. Wow.
origin: Owen Wilson's signature 'wow', an internet institution.
